name: advanced-editor-tools
notes: Adapter-authoring probe 2026-08-22: inspected the official WordPress.org Advanced Editor Tools 5.9.2 artifact (SHA-256 ec4c6635dc9d0f9c27d0256d7b83b3655b5904c936748604c698d256fbfd69c7). The range is intentionally one patch wide: widening requires another artifact probe, not an assumption that persisted settings stayed compatible.

tinymce-advanced.php load_settings()/save_settings() and tadv_admin.php's built-in JSON import/export identify tadv_settings and tadv_admin_settings as the complete current portable settings pair. Their arrays contain editor option names, plugin names, toolbar button names, and feature flags; the inspected write path contains no entity ids, host-bound paths, or credentials.

tadv_version is the integer upgrade gate. The eight tadv_options/tadv_toolbars/tadv_plugins/tadv_btns*/tadv_allbtns rows are pre-4.x migration inputs that update_settings() deletes; all are runtime upgrade residue, not current editor configuration. The adapter is experimental until a clean-target editor render and settings round-trip exercise the exact artifact.
